details.summary: An excellent, highly practical no-cook lunch recipe that perfectly hits the Mediterranean flavor profile and the dietary needs of the reader. Minor adjustments to the tortilla weight specification and the sun-dried tomato preparation will make it flawless.

dimensions.feedback: The combination of lemon, oregano, sun-dried tomatoes, and artichokes creates a vibrant, classic Mediterranean flavor profile. Using mashed cannellini beans as a creamy binder instead of mayonnaise is both clever and delicious.
All ingredients listed are correctly and sequentially utilized in the instructions.

Dry-packed sun-dried tomatoes can be quite tough and leathery if chopped and eaten raw in a cold wrap. Consider either adding a quick step to soak them in hot water for 5 minutes before chopping, or simply change the ingredient to 'oil-packed (rinsed and drained)'.
Perfectly aligns with Mediterranean-American cuisine, relying on olive oil, white beans, artichokes, and bright lemon flavors.
The no-cook, mash-and-assemble method is highly suitable and practical for these ingredients.
The values are highly plausible. The slight carbohydrate overage is directly attributable to the large weight given for the tortillas (120g total, meaning 60g per wrap).
The title accurately describes the dish. The intro sets realistic expectations for a desk lunch, praises the bean substitution gracefully, and contains no disallowed health claims.
An incredibly appealing and practical recipe. It offers excellent texture contrast and rich, savory flavors without feeling like 'diet food'.
